verdict.rationale: Hummingbird documents validating cases against a given jurisdiction, then filing them and monitoring status (hummingbird-docs-5). FinCEN filings are trackable and can be batched (hummingbird-docs-10, hummingbird-docs-11), and the report draws on case evidence such as attachments and narrative templates, with the filing institution applied to cases (hummingbird-docs-6, hummingbird-docs-13, hummingbird-docs-12). missing for 10: detailed docs on SAR form preparation and narrative drafting from case evidence, evidence of jurisdictions beyond FinCEN, independent or hands-on corroboration.
